name: Kivik Lir's Temple
title: 38.1S, 47.3W - Kivik Lir's Temple
summary: A horned Falacatot temple (24 m square, 17 m, spire roof, archway entrance) on the mud flats of the Direlands swamp at 38.1S 47.3W, with a still stream/pond running west-north-west of it (y 15348-15372), ore outcrops, carts and blades of a Burun camp around it. Its dungeons (Center of / Secrets of Kivik Lir's Temple) are underground; only the surface temple is filmed.

site.name: Kivik Lir's Temple
site.notes: Derived teleport (no gazetteer outdoor entry within 300 m): 30 m north of the temple on the stream bank, 6 m from the nearest bush.
